stories.title: Sign up, log in, and end an authenticated session
stories.outcome: A visitor can create a Recruit account, authenticate through an eight-hour opaque cookie session, and log out.

acceptance_criteria.given: an unauthenticated visitor provides valid Recruit profile fields and an 8–128 character password
acceptance_criteria.when: sign-up is submitted without role or assignment fields
acceptance_criteria.then: a Recruit account is created with case-insensitive unique email and a PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hash
acceptance_criteria.verification: API integration, credential-storage inspection, and Playwright test

acceptance_criteria.given: an active account with valid email and password
acceptance_criteria.when: the user logs in and later logs out
acceptance_criteria.then: an HttpOnly SameSite=Lax opaque server session valid for eight hours is created, protected access succeeds, and logout invalidates and clears it
acceptance_criteria.verification: API cookie/session assertions and Playwright test

acceptance_criteria.given: duplicate email, client-supplied privileged role, invalid credentials, or an expired/missing session
acceptance_criteria.then: the specified 409, 422, or generic 401 error occurs without storing plaintext credentials or exposing account/protected data

definition_of_ready: Section 5 authentication contract accepted with this plan
Bootstrap Admin environment variables available to the implementation environment

stories.title: View and maintain an approved user profile
stories.outcome: An authorized user can view and, where approved, update profile data.

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user
acceptance_criteria.then: name, email, role, department, and start date are returned without password or session data

acceptance_criteria.given: a user patches own name, email, department, or start date, or attempts role/assignment changes
acceptance_criteria.then: self-editable fields update while role and assignment fields are rejected unless changed through an Admin endpoint

acceptance_criteria.given: duplicate/malformed email, invalid date, empty/overlength name or department, or an unknown field
acceptance_criteria.when: the profile is created or updated
acceptance_criteria.then: the specified 409 or 422 error occurs and invalid data is not stored

definition_of_ready: Profile ownership/edit matrix and section 6 field rules accepted with this plan

stories.title: Enforce recruit, manager, and admin access boundaries
stories.outcome: Every protected operation and record is restricted by the approved role and ownership model.

acceptance_criteria.given: a Recruit requests or mutates diary data
acceptance_criteria.then: create/view/edit/delete succeeds only for records owned by that Recruit

acceptance_criteria.given: a Manager requests or mutates diary data
acceptance_criteria.when: the target is assigned or unassigned
acceptance_criteria.then: create/view/edit/delete succeeds only for assigned recruits and is 403 otherwise

acceptance_criteria.given: a Manager requests a report for a recruit
acceptance_criteria.when: the recruit is assigned or unassigned
acceptance_criteria.then: generation succeeds only for the Admin-maintained assignment and is 403 otherwise

acceptance_criteria.given: an unauthenticated request or an authenticated request outside role scope
acceptance_criteria.then: the API returns 401 or 403 in the specified error envelope without leaking record existence or data

definition_of_ready: Section 2 role, ownership, and one-manager-per-recruit model accepted with this plan

stories.title: Administer users and inspect all authorized data
stories.outcome: An admin can perform the approved user-management operations and view all application data.

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated Admin
acceptance_criteria.when: the Admin lists users or accesses diary data
acceptance_criteria.then: all users and all diary records are visible and CRUD-capable

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated Admin
acceptance_criteria.when: the Admin creates, patches, or deletes a user or puts/deletes a recruit's manager assignment
acceptance_criteria.then: field/role rules and the zero-or-one-manager constraint apply; role changes invalidate sessions/invalid links; user deletion cascades owned records, sessions, and links; deleting self or the last Admin returns 409
acceptance_criteria.verification: Admin operation matrix and cascade tests

acceptance_criteria.given: a non-admin
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin operation or all-data view is requested
acceptance_criteria.then: access is denied without changing data

definition_of_ready: Admin endpoints and role powers in sections 2 and 7 accepted with this plan

stories.title: Maintain and filter task entries
stories.outcome: An authorized recruit can create, view, edit, delete, and filter task entries.

acceptance_criteria.given: task fields satisfying section 6
acceptance_criteria.when: an authorized actor creates a task in role scope
acceptance_criteria.then: the task is stored with owner, date, title, description, category, status, and priority and appears in the scoped task log

acceptance_criteria.given: an existing in-scope task
acceptance_criteria.when: an authorized actor partially edits mutable fields
acceptance_criteria.then: only supplied valid fields update and immutable ID/owner changes are rejected

acceptance_criteria.given: an existing in-scope task
acceptance_criteria.then: the API returns 204 and the permanently deleted task is no longer returned

acceptance_criteria.given: tasks spanning dates and the specified category/status enums
acceptance_criteria.when: date, category, and/or status filters are applied
acceptance_criteria.then: AND-combined filters return only authorized matches ordered by date, created_at, and ID descending

acceptance_criteria.given: invalid/unknown fields or a task outside caller scope
acceptance_criteria.when: create, edit, delete, or view is attempted
acceptance_criteria.then: 422 or 403 occurs and no unauthorized mutation occurs

definition_of_ready: Task enums, field rules, ownership, sorting, and filters in sections 6–7 accepted with this plan

stories.title: Log and filter issues or blockers
stories.outcome: An authorized recruit can record issues and use the approved lifecycle and filters.

acceptance_criteria.given: issue fields satisfying section 6
acceptance_criteria.when: an authorized actor creates an issue in role scope
acceptance_criteria.then: the issue is stored with the specified fields and appears in the scoped issue log

acceptance_criteria.given: an existing in-scope issue
acceptance_criteria.when: an authorized actor views, patches, or deletes it
acceptance_criteria.then: full CRUD succeeds, 204 permanent delete is used, and resolution notes are required for Resolved or Closed

acceptance_criteria.given: issues spanning the specified statuses and severities
acceptance_criteria.when: status and/or severity filters are applied
acceptance_criteria.then: AND-combined filters return only authorized matches in the specified descending order

acceptance_criteria.given: invalid fields, missing resolution notes, or an out-of-scope issue
acceptance_criteria.then: 422 or 403 occurs without unauthorized mutation

definition_of_ready: Issue lifecycle, enums, validation, ownership, and filters in sections 6–7 accepted with this plan

stories.title: Submit onboarding feedback
stories.outcome: An authorized recruit can submit feedback classified as Positive, Suggestion, or Concern.

acceptance_criteria.given: valid date, 1–120 subject, Positive/Suggestion/Concern type, and 1–2000 details
acceptance_criteria.when: an authorized actor submits feedback in role scope
acceptance_criteria.then: the feedback is stored and displayed within that scope

acceptance_criteria.given: an unsupported type or missing/overlength field
acceptance_criteria.then: 422 occurs and no record is stored

acceptance_criteria.given: existing feedback
acceptance_criteria.when: view, partial edit, or permanent delete is attempted
acceptance_criteria.then: full CRUD succeeds only within Recruit/assigned-Manager/Admin scope and is 403 otherwise

definition_of_ready: Feedback lifecycle and section 6 validation accepted with this plan

stories.title: Capture tagged additional notes
stories.outcome: An authorized recruit can capture free-form dated notes with titles and tags.

acceptance_criteria.given: valid date, 1–120 title, 1–5000 content, and zero to ten tags
acceptance_criteria.when: an authorized actor saves a note in role scope
acceptance_criteria.then: the note is stored and tags are trimmed, lowercased, and de-duplicated

acceptance_criteria.given: empty required data, more than ten tags, or a tag outside 1–30 characters after trimming
acceptance_criteria.then: 422 occurs and no invalid note is stored

acceptance_criteria.given: an existing note
acceptance_criteria.when: view, partial edit, or permanent delete is attempted
acceptance_criteria.then: full CRUD succeeds only within Recruit/assigned-Manager/Admin scope and is 403 otherwise

definition_of_ready: Note lifecycle and tag rules in section 6 accepted with this plan

stories.title: View dashboard counts and recent diary entries
stories.outcome: An authorized user sees accurate, scoped counts and recent entries across diary categories.

acceptance_criteria.given: known fixtures for one recruit
acceptance_criteria.when: self, assigned Manager, or Admin loads that recruit's dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: task, issue, feedback, and note counts match only that recruit's records

acceptance_criteria.given: more than ten mixed diary records with date/timestamp ties
acceptance_criteria.then: exactly ten are returned by date, created_at, and ID descending

acceptance_criteria.given: an out-of-scope target or an in-scope recruit with no entries
acceptance_criteria.then: 403 occurs for out-of-scope access or zero counts and a clear empty state appear without data leakage

definition_of_ready: Dashboard scope/count/recent rules in section 8 accepted with this plan

stories.title: View task progress and open issues
stories.outcome: An authorized user sees the approved task-completion calculation and open-issue summary.

acceptance_criteria.given: tasks in all four specified statuses
acceptance_criteria.then: Completed divided by all tasks times 100 is rounded to the nearest whole percent

acceptance_criteria.given: issues in all four specified statuses
acceptance_criteria.then: only Open and In Progress issues for the selected recruit are included

acceptance_criteria.given: zero tasks or zero open issues
acceptance_criteria.then: progress is 0%, open count is zero, and no divide-by-zero or stale data appears

definition_of_ready: Task completion and open-status definitions in section 8 accepted with this plan

stories.title: Generate scoped date-range reports
stories.outcome: An authorized user can request task, issue, feedback, or combined data for an approved date range.

acceptance_criteria.given: authorized records inside and outside a date range
acceptance_criteria.when: tasks, issues, feedback, or combined type is requested
acceptance_criteria.then: only inclusive in-range records appear with section 9 columns ordered by date, record type, and ID ascending

acceptance_criteria.given: equal, reversed, missing, or valid boundary dates
acceptance_criteria.then: equal dates include that day, reversed/missing dates return 422, and both valid endpoints are inclusive

acceptance_criteria.given: a manager and an assigned recruit
acceptance_criteria.when: the manager requests the recruit's report
acceptance_criteria.then: generation succeeds within the approved scope

acceptance_criteria.given: a manager and an unassigned recruit or other unauthorized target
acceptance_criteria.then: generation is denied and no report data is returned

definition_of_ready: Report selection/date/content and oversight contracts in sections 2 and 9 accepted with this plan

stories.title: Download report output as PDF or CSV
stories.outcome: An authorized report request produces a parseable PDF or CSV containing the approved content.

acceptance_criteria.given: an authorized report result
acceptance_criteria.then: a parseable PDF contains title, recruit, inclusive dates, UTC generation timestamp, readable logical columns, ordered rows, and the specified filename

acceptance_criteria.given: an authorized report result
acceptance_criteria.then: a UTF-8 RFC 4180 CSV contains the section 9 header and ordered rows with the specified filename

acceptance_criteria.given: an authorized range with no matching data
acceptance_criteria.then: a valid artifact downloads with CSV headers or PDF metadata plus No records found

acceptance_criteria.given: an unauthorized request or simulated generation failure
acceptance_criteria.then: 403 or safe 500 occurs, no partial/protected file is exposed, criteria remain entered, and retry is available

definition_of_ready: PDF/CSV schema, filename, empty, and failure contract in sections 9–10 accepted with this plan

stories.title: Run the application on the mandated simple stack
stories.outcome: The frontend, backend, and database use the mandated technologies with an approved data lifetime.

acceptance_criteria.given: documented local prerequisites and bootstrap Admin email/password environment variables
acceptance_criteria.then: the React/Vite/Tailwind frontend and single-process FastAPI backend start and bootstrap one Admin; missing variables fail startup clearly
acceptance_criteria.verification: Dependency inspection and startup smoke tests

acceptance_criteria.given: the running application
acceptance_criteria.when: the frontend performs a supported operation
acceptance_criteria.then: it communicates with FastAPI and the operation uses SQLite configured in-memory
acceptance_criteria.verification: End-to-end smoke test and configuration inspection

acceptance_criteria.given: stored users, sessions, assignments, and diary data
acceptance_criteria.then: all prior in-memory data may be absent and a new empty database plus bootstrap Admin is created

definition_of_ready: Single-process ephemeral lifecycle and bootstrap behavior in section 4 accepted with this plan

stories.title: Use core flows responsively
stories.outcome: Approved core pages remain usable at approved desktop and mobile viewport sizes.

acceptance_criteria.given: each core page in current Playwright Chromium at 390x844
acceptance_criteria.then: navigation, forms, lists, and downloads remain reachable with no page-level horizontal overflow

acceptance_criteria.given: each core page in current Playwright Chromium at 1280x720
acceptance_criteria.then: all required data and controls are visible or reachable and no required action is hidden

acceptance_criteria.given: 390x844 and maximum-length representative content
acceptance_criteria.when: forms, tags, errors, and report controls render
acceptance_criteria.then: content remains accessible using responsive cards or a bounded table scroll region

definition_of_ready: Chromium viewport and overflow rules in section 10 accepted with this plan

stories.title: Handle validation, authorization, and operational failures
stories.outcome: Users receive approved, safe, recoverable behavior when core operations cannot succeed.

acceptance_criteria.given: invalid input in any core form or API
acceptance_criteria.then: 422 uses the specified envelope, inline field errors preserve other values, and invalid data is not stored

acceptance_criteria.given: expired, missing, or insufficient authorization
acceptance_criteria.then: 401 clears client state and redirects to login or 403 shows access denied without data exposure

acceptance_criteria.given: a missing resource, duplicate email, or invalid state transition
acceptance_criteria.then: 404 or 409 uses the specified safe envelope without corrupting data

acceptance_criteria.given: a simulated backend/network or report-generation failure
acceptance_criteria.then: a generic retryable banner appears, no password/session/diary content is logged, successful data remains, and no partial report downloads

definition_of_ready: Error/status/envelope, logging, and recovery behavior in sections 7, 10, and 11 accepted with this plan

stories.title: Defer extension feature one until post-MVP planning
stories.outcome: The first extension remains outside MVP generation until a future approved specification selects it.

acceptance_criteria.given: the current MVP plan
acceptance_criteria.when: generation scope and execution waves are inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: E006-S001 is marked deferred and absent from generation payloads and MVP waves

acceptance_criteria.given: the core MVP has been implemented and proven
acceptance_criteria.then: a future revision must select and specify actors, behavior, validation, authorization, data, tests, and exclusions before implementation

definition_of_ready: Not applicable to MVP; future planning approval required

stories.title: Defer extension feature two until post-MVP planning
stories.outcome: The second extension remains outside MVP generation until a future approved specification selects it.

acceptance_criteria.given: the current MVP plan
acceptance_criteria.when: generation scope and execution waves are inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: E006-S002 is marked deferred and absent from generation payloads and MVP waves

acceptance_criteria.given: the core MVP has been implemented and proven
acceptance_criteria.then: a future revision must select and specify actors, behavior, validation, authorization, data, tests, and exclusions before implementation

definition_of_ready: Not applicable to MVP; future planning approval required
